info.title: Vision Lens
info.description: Vision Lens — Visual Intelligence Engineering Workbench. Generated from @vision-lens/contracts, the single source of truth for the domain model and the operations of the platform (constitution III, contracts-first). The entity schemas are served unchanged by the API service of spec 009.

EntityId.title: EntityId
EntityId.description: Identity of an entity: a UUIDv7 (time-ordered, index-friendly).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Point in time an event was recorded, with an explicit UTC offset.

Sha256.title: Sha256
Sha256.description: Content hash of a file or of a hashed payload: 64 lowercase hex characters.

Region.title: Region
Region.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in the pixel space of the source asset.

JsonValue.title: JsonValue
JsonValue.description: An arbitrary JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: Any producer of a record: a human, a model or an agent.

AnnotationActor.title: AnnotationActor
AnnotationActor.description: The producers allowed to author an Annotation: a human or an agent.

PredictionActor.title: PredictionActor
PredictionActor.description: The only producer allowed to author a Prediction: a model.

ActorKind.title: ActorKind
ActorKind.description: Who produced a record: a person, a model, or an agent.

Surface.title: Surface
Surface.description: Tool surface a record was produced through (CLI / Studio / API / MCP / agent).

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description: Lifecycle state of any long-running job (experiment, evaluation, agent run).

SplitKind.title: SplitKind
SplitKind.description: Dataset split a sample belongs to; `unassigned` means "not yet split".

RegistryState.title: RegistryState
RegistryState.description: Publication state of a model version in the registry.

AgentToolTier.title: AgentToolTier
AgentToolTier.description: Permission tier of an agent tool call (constitution VI).

FeedbackKind.title: FeedbackKind
FeedbackKind.description: Kind of feedback captured for a sample (correction / flag / production signal).

CaptureSession.title: CaptureSession
CaptureSession.description: A capture session: one device/camera producing a stream of frames.

Sample.title: Sample
Sample.description: A labelled unit of observation: one asset, optionally one region of it.

OntologyVersion.title: OntologyVersion
OntologyVersion.description: An immutable version of the label taxonomy.

Annotation.title: Annotation
Annotation.description: A human- (or agent-) authored ground-truth label.

DatasetSnapshot.title: DatasetSnapshot
DatasetSnapshot.description: An immutable, content-addressed view of a dataset.

ExperimentRun.title: ExperimentRun
ExperimentRun.description: One run of the pipeline (classify / train / eval / arena / al / agent).

ModelVersion.title: ModelVersion
ModelVersion.description: A versioned model in the registry.

EvaluationRun.title: EvaluationRun
EvaluationRun.description: The measured evaluation of one experiment under a named protocol.

Deployment.title: Deployment
Deployment.description: A model version made available on a target.

FeedbackEvent.title: FeedbackEvent
FeedbackEvent.description: A signal captured about a sample: a human correction, a flag, or a production observation.

AgentRun.title: AgentRun
AgentRun.description: One agent investigation: a goal, a budget, the tool calls it made, the approvals it needed and the report it produced.

items.description: One tool invocation performed by an agent.
A human decision about a gated action.

DerivedArtifact.title: DerivedArtifact
DerivedArtifact.description: An artifact derived from original assets (thumbnail, embedding, report, mask, crop).
